newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-LATE PENALTY COSTS REAL AGAINST VALENCIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATE PENALTY COSTS REAL AGAINST VALENCIA.

text.p: A late Burrito Ortega penalty for Valencia denied Real Madrid the chance of restoring their 10-point lead at the top of the Spanish first division on Monday.
The 1-1 draw left Real eight points clear of arch-rivals Barcelona with seven games left to play.
Argentine midfielder Burrito Ortega converted the 87th minute penalty after Fernando Hierro had upended striker Leandro.
Ortega celebrated the goal by taking his shirt off, but avoided a yellow card when his Valencia team mates surrounded him to prevent the referee seeing the infringement.
Earlier Real midfielder Clarence Seedorf had forced a mistake by Valencia defender Jose Ignacio in the 63rd minute, and Raul Gonzalez was on hand to knock the ball past keeper Andoni Zubizarreta.
